from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

input_path = Path("results/thermal_probe_history.csv")
output_dir = Path("postprocessed/thermal")
output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

temperature = pd.read_csv(input_path)
required = {"probe_id", "time_s", "temperature_c"}
missing = required.difference(temperature.columns)
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing thermal result columns: {sorted(missing)}")

temperature = temperature.sort_values(["probe_id", "time_s"]).copy()
groups = temperature.groupby("probe_id", sort=False)
# Calculate the interval cooling rate separately for each probe.
time_step = groups["time_s"].diff()
temperature_step = groups["temperature_c"].diff()
temperature["cooling_rate_c_per_s"] = -temperature_step / time_step
temperature = temperature.replace([float("inf"), -float("inf")], pd.NA)
temperature = temperature.dropna(subset=["time_s", "temperature_c", "cooling_rate_c_per_s"])
temperature = temperature[time_step.loc[temperature.index] > 0]
if temperature.empty:
    raise ValueError("No valid positive-duration temperature intervals are available.")

temperature.to_csv(output_dir / "probe_cooling_rates.csv", index=False)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5))
for probe_id, group in temperature.groupby("probe_id", sort=True):
    ax.plot(group["time_s"], group["cooling_rate_c_per_s"], label=str(probe_id), linewidth=1.4)
ax.set_xlabel("Time (s)")
ax.set_ylabel("Cooling rate (°C/s)")
ax.set_title("Transient cooling rate by probe")
ax.legend(title="Probe", ncol=2)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.25)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(output_dir / "probe_cooling_rates.png", dpi=160)
plt.close(fig)
